title: 利用大语言模型进行情感分析：Decentraland MANA代币的多模态分析
summary: 研究利用BERT大语言模型分析Decentraland Discord社区情感，结合多模态金融数据（价格、交易量、市值）预测MANA代币价格。多模态LSTM模型显著优于仅基于价格的基线模型，证明了社区信号对虚拟经济预测的价值。
summary_en: This study uses a BERT-based LLM for sentiment analysis of Decentraland's Discord community and integrates multi-modal financial data to predict MANA token prices. The multi-modal LSTM model significantly outperforms the price-only baseline, demonstrating the predictive value of community signals.
